summary: Intellia Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with Jefferies, Goldman Sachs, and Citigroup for a public offering of 16,744,187 shares of common stock at $10.75 per share, plus full exercise of the underwriters' 30-day option for an additional 2,511,628 shares. The offering closed on April 30, 2026, raising net proceeds of approximately $194.6 million. Proceeds will fund clinical development, R&D, working capital, and potential acquisitions. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, not a special situation. The sale of shares by the registrant is an ordinary capital-raising event.
